Product features

  • Tempered glass surface, durable and impact resistant: The tabletop is made of 27.5-inch high transparency tempered glass, which can be wiped clean with just one wipe, making maintenance worry free. The edges are rounded and chamfered, balancing aesthetics and safety, making it a choice for light luxury at home.
  • Wide chassis, stable and sturdy: paired with a 19.4-inch diameter silver metal base, the structure is solid and balanced, greatly reducing the risk of rollover. Metal columns have strong load-bearing capacity and will not deform after long-term use. The base comes with anti slip foot pads to protect the floor and move silently.
  • Light luxury color scheme, versatile space: classic silver metal base paired with transparent glass countertop, full of light luxury contrasting color and high-end feeling. The circular design is visually lightweight and does not steal the space spotlight, perfectly adapting to various home decoration styles such as modern and light luxury.
  • Golden ratio, dual-use for one table: The total height is 17.7 inches, suitable for sofa height, and the 27.5-inch large tabletop is enough to hold tea and snacks. Can be used as a coffee table, balcony leisure table, or study side table, with one table for multiple purposes without taking up space.
  • Transparent and spacious, savior for small apartments: Transparent glass tabletop is transparent and unobstructed, visually enlarging the space and solving the feeling of crowding and suppression in small apartments. Lightweight design does not take up space, perfectly adapting to various corners such as living rooms, bedrooms, and study rooms, enhancing the transparency and sophistication of the space.
  • Single package shipping, worry free installation: Single package shipping, tightly packed and anti-collision. Simple structure with few accessories, no need for complex tools, can be quickly installed by a single person in 10-20 minutes, and comes with detailed instructions.
  • Attention: Due to different display devices and lighting conditions, there may be slight color differences between the actual product and the image. This is normal. The manually measured dimensions may have slight errors, please refer to the actual product dimensions received. Thank you for your understanding.
